title: Understanding the Sampling Frame
text: Think about the group of individuals from which Rachel could potentially select her sample. This group should include everyone who could have been chosen, not just those who were actually selected.

title: Defining the Sampling Frame
text: The sampling frame is essentially the list or database from which the sample is drawn. Consider what list Rachel used to select the 12,000 students.

title: Identifying the Correct Sampling Frame
text: Which of the following best describes the sampling frame in Rachel's study?
choices: >UC Berkeley students who use Bay Area transit
